text: The accepted native selectFlagged command suppresses selection events while clearing/toggling Marked rows, then unsuppresses events and invalidates either tree interface. The about3Pane command also dispatches its select event. Keep these separate steps when changing the selection contract: updating selected indices does not itself prove that row styles or message-pane consumers refreshed. title: Selecting starred rows needs a repaint and a selection signal
